title: Order Request
description: Each order has a unique identifier generated by Moment. The ID will be returned when an order is placed and can be used to check the status of the order via the `GET /v1/trading/order/{id}/` endpoint. Updates on open orders at Moment will also be sent over the real-time API, which is the recommended method of maintaining order state.

account_booking_type.description: Deprecated, will be removed soon. Use account_configuration.booking_type instead.

booking_instructions.description: Client-provided information to configure trade booking for the order, as a map from string to string. Passing a multi-layer JSON map or something other than "string":"string" key-value pairs will result in an error. The specific contents of this field should be determined in conjunction with the back-office integration.
booking_instructions.title: booking_instructions

bypass_auto_execution.description: Flag to indicate if auto execution rules should be bypassed

counter_expiry_time.description: The time until which the counter is valid

custodian_id.description:
The Moment-provided custodian ID that the corresponding account belongs to.

For organizations with CTM enabled, this field should be left empty for both single and block fixed-income orders.
For brokerages firms, `custodian_id` and `account_id` are both required to identify the inventory account.
For RIAs, this field is optional as each account allocation has its own custodian_id field.

When available, it is recommended to populate this field.
custodian_id.title: Custodian ID

execution_instructions.description: A list of execution instructions for the order

expire_date.description: Date of order expiration (last day the order can trade), always expressed in terms of the local market date. The maximum expire_date is 90 calendar days out. If the expire_date does not fall on a trading day, the next trading day is automatically selected.

explicit_cancelation_required.description:
Deprecated. The value provided here is ignored — orders are always
treated as if explicit cancellation is required. The field is kept
for backwards compatibility and will be removed in a future release.

fees.description:
Custom fees to be applied to the order. If provided, this list overrides the default fees defined in the system.

For each fee recipient based on the trade structure, a separate fee object should be included.
For example, in a trade flow like:

  Street <-> Executing Broker <-> Introducing Broker <-> Customer

where both brokers are charging fees, you would specify:

  "fees": [
    {
      "fee_type": "markup",
      "fee_amount_type": "percentage_of_par",
      "fee_amount": 0.01,
      "recipient": "<org_id_of_executing_broker>"
    },
    {
      "fee_type": "markup",
      "fee_amount_type": "percentage_of_par",
      "fee_amount": 0.05,
      "recipient": "<org_id_of_introducing_broker>"
    }
  ]

for_block_trade.description: Flag to indicate if the order is for a block trade, used for post order allocation

group_members.description: List of group members for the order

ib_id.description: The introducing broker ID to use for this specific order. If not specified, will use the introducing broker ID from the bulk request.

is_counter.description: Flag to indicate if the order is a counter

is_group_order.description: Flag to indicate if the order is a group order

liquidate_fund_position.description: Flag to instruct the custodian to sell the entire position rather than just the quantity on the order. Fund sells only and notional. The notional dollar value should be the current notional value of the position.

metadata.description: Custom metadata for the order. This can be used to store additional information about the order that is not covered by the other fields. The keys and values are both strings.

order_rfq_ids.description: A list of existing RFQ IDs to associate with this order.

review_reason.description: Reason for why the order requires review. Only applicable when review_required is true.

review_required.description: Flag to indicate if the order requires manual review before execution.

risk_group_id.description: The risk group ID to use for this specific order. If not specified, will use the risk group ID from the bulk request.

settlement_date.description: The targeted settlement date for the order in the format of YYYYMMDD, like 20090101

time_in_force.description: Time in force for the order. Acceptable values are `day` and `good_till_date`. Absence is interpreted as `day`.

prime_brokerage_enabled.description: Whether the prime brokerage is enabled for the account.

household_id.description: The ID of the household for the account.

manager_id.description:
The accounts-service platform advisor for the account: an
account group, not a person. The person credited with the trade
is iar.

custodian_advisor_id.description:
The custodian's own identifier for the manager_id account group at
this custodian: the rep code. Stored as sent.

custodian_tax_lot_id.description: The tax lot ID assigned by the custodian. Deprecated, use lot_instruction.custodian_tax_lot_id instead.

is_discretionary.description: Whether the introducing broker exercised discretion on behalf of the end client on this particular order.

is_solicited.description: Whether the order was solicited. Must be unset if the order is discretionary.

is_natural_person.description:
Whether the account is held by a natural person rather than a
legal entity. Omit when the holder cannot be classified, as a
trust or an estate may not be. An attestation control can be
limited to the accounts this is true of.

AggressivenessLevel.title: Aggressiveness Level
AggressivenessLevel.description:
Execution aggressiveness for a custodian algo. Required by some custodians (e.g. Fidelity);
ignored by custodians without an equivalent concept (e.g. Schwab).

AlgoParameters.title: Algo Parameters
AlgoParameters.description:
Execution parameters for custodian algos. Exactly one of `twap`, `vwap`, `pov`, or `is` must be set.
Only supported on the custodian protocol with the manual strategy. Fields or values not accepted
by a given custodian are rejected downstream.

AllOrNone.description: If set to true, the entire order quantity will be filled or none at all. There will be no partial fills.
AllOrNone.title: All or None

AllocationAccountRequest.title: Allocation Account Request
AllocationAccountRequest.description:
The account allocation request specifies the amount of the order to allocate to a specific account.
Note that requested_amount values must be a multiple of the par size of the bond.

client_account_allocation_id.description: Client-provided unique ID for the account allocation; for example, to cross-reference with an internal system. Values must be unique within the trading day.

moment_sleeve_id.description: The Moment internal ID of the sleeve to allocate the order to.

order_received_at.description: When the end client confirmed the order for this account.

order_received_by.description: Who took that confirmation, by Moment user reference or by name.

strategy.description:
Strategy for allocation. Determines how the block's filled quantity is distributed across requested accounts.
- `fifo_without_averaging`: allocates on a first-in, first-out basis without averaging; preserves individual trade prices per allocation.
- `fifo_with_averaging`: allocates first-in, first-out and applies the block's average fill price to each allocation.
- `pro_rata_with_averaging`: allocates pro-rata across requested accounts and applies the block's average fill price. Typically used for equity and ETF block orders.

**RIA accounts must use `fifo_without_averaging`.** The averaging
strategies (`fifo_with_averaging`, `pro_rata_with_averaging`) require a
principal/averaging trading account to average executions before they are
booked to client accounts. RIAs trade in an agency capacity and must report
the actual street-execution prices and quantities to their custodian (e.g.
Schwab), so each allocation has to match a real executed trade. Because there
is no averaging account to absorb the difference, averaged allocation is not
available to RIAs — only the non-averaging FIFO strategy, which preserves the
true per-trade execution prices, is supported.

account_allocations.description: Account allocations for an individual order

Annotation.description: Client-provided custom metadata for the order.
Annotation.title: annotation

BookingType.title: BookingType
BookingType.description: The booking type for the account.

ClientOrderID.title: Client Order ID
ClientOrderID.description: Client-provided unique ID for the order; for example, to cross-reference with an internal system. Must be unique within the trading day, otherwise duplicate orders will be rejected during pre-trade checks.

CounterExpiryTime.description: The time until which the counter is valid.

CustodianID.description: The Moment-provided ID of the custodian for the order. Custodians must be enabled per risk group.
CustodianID.title: Custodian ID

min_wait_time.description: Minimum wait time for the execution order.

min_number_quotes.description: Minimum number of quotes required on the side of the order, before execution can proceed. If the protocol is `request_for_quote`, this is the minimum number of RFQ quotes required. If the protocol is `limit_order_book`, this is the minimum number of LOB quotes required.

max_transaction_cost_dollar.description: Maximum transaction cost in dollars. Max buy price = estimated price * par value + maxDollar, Min sell price = estimated price * par value - maxDollar. Ex. a value of `5` would mean the transaction cost must be within $5 of the instrument's estimated price in dollars, meaning when buying a bond with a estimated price of $100 and a par value of $1000, the transaction cost must be below $1005.

max_transaction_cost_percent.description: Maximum transaction cost in percent. Max buy price = estimated price * (1 + maxPct / 100), Min sell price = estimated price * (1 - maxPct / 100). Ex. a value of `5` would mean the transaction cost must be within 5% of the instrument's estimated price in percent, meaning when buying a bond with a estimated price of $100, the transaction cost must be below $105.

max_transaction_cost_yield.description: Maximum transaction cost in yield. Max buy yield = estimated ytw - maxYTW, Max sell yield = estimated ytw + maxYTW. Ex. a value of `0.5` would mean the transaction cost must be within 50 bps of the instrument's estimated yield, meaning when buying a bond with an estimated yield to worst of 1.5%, the transaction cost must be above 1.0%.

ExecutionInstruction.title: Execution Instruction
ExecutionInstruction.description: Instructions for the EMS on how to execute the order.

client_execution_order_id.description: The client-provided ID for the execution order.

suppress_pmp_check.description: Flag to toggle if the Prevailing Market Price (PMP) check should be suppressed for the execution order.

venue_trader_info.description: A list of venue trader info for the execution order.

rfq_protocol_parameters.description: A list of RFQ protocol parameters for the execution order.

venue_mpid.description: MPID of the venue to trade on.

skip_lob_quotes.description: Only for auto-RFQ orders, flag to determine whether to skip matching against the limit order book quotes and only match against RFQ quotes. Must be set if the protocol is `request_for_quote` and the strategy is `auto_ex`.

all_or_none.description: Flag to indicate whether the order should be executed as an all-or-none order. If set to true, the order will only be executed if the entire quantity can be filled.

trader_profile.description: The trader assigned to this execution instruction.

ruleset_metadata.description: Metadata about the ruleset that auto generated the order.

is_counter.description: Flag to indicate if the order is a counter

counter_expires_after.description: Duration in seconds until which the counter is valid

time_in_force.description: Time in force for the execution instruction. Acceptable values are `day`, `good_till_date`, `at_the_opening`, and `at_the_close`. Absence is interpreted as `day`.

ExtendedHours.description:
Deprecated. The value provided here is ignored — acceptance hours are
determined by the instrument's asset class: fixed income orders are
accepted from 7:30 am to 5:30 pm ET, orders for other asset classes
from 7:30 am to 4:00 pm ET. The field is kept for backwards
compatibility and will be removed in a future release.

bypass_street_side_leg.description: Flag to bypass street side leg. If true, we will not send the street side to the custodian.

bypass_trade_booking.description: Flag to bypass trade booking. If true, the trade will not be booked in the system.

counterparty_clearing_firm_id.description: DTC ID of the counterparty's clearing firm.

counterparty_id.description: MPID of the counterparty involved in the street trade.

execution_id.description: Trade ID. Often times this will be the ID of the execution made at an external venue.

external_trade_report_id.description:
Optional external trade report ID. If provided, this ID will be used instead of auto-generating one.
Must start with 'etr_' followed by a valid ULID.
If not provided, the system will generate a unique ID automatically.

price.description: The trade price. For mutual funds, if not provided, the backend will use the parent order's estimated price (NAV).

settle_date.description: The settlement date for the trade.

snapshot_id.description: Optional quote snapshot ID. If provided, this snapshot ID will be used instead of creating a new one.

trade_time.description: The timestamp when the trade occurred.

Fee.title: Fee
Fee.description: The fee to apply to the order.

recipient_id.description: Unique ID of the recipient of the fee.

fee_amount.description: Fee amount to apply to the order.

max_fee_amount.description: Maximum fee amount to apply to the order.

fee_name.description: Optional name for the fee, for easier identification.

FeeAmountType.title: Fee Amount Type
FeeAmountType.description:
The method used to calculate the fee amount. Supported types include:

- `percentage_of_par`: Fee as a percentage of par value.
  Example: `0.10` = 10 basis points of par value.

- `percentage_of_market_value`: Fee as a percentage of the quote price (market value).
  Example: `1` = 1% of market value.

- `yield_bps`: Fee expressed in yield terms, in basis points.
  Example: `100` = 100 basis points of yield.

- `percentage_of_concession`: Fee applies to concession based quoting mechanism, especially for new issue CDs.
  Example: `50` = 50 percent of all concession from the dealer.

FeeType.title: Fee Type
FeeType.description: The type of fee to apply to the order. Valid values are "markup", "commission", and "sales_credit".

GroupMember.title: Group Member
GroupMember.description: A group member for an order

moment_order_id.description: The ID of the order in the group

IntroducingBrokerID.description: The ID of the introducing broker placing the order. If not specified, the organization associated with the API key will be used.

InvestmentAdvisorRepresentative.title: Investment Advisor Representative
InvestmentAdvisorRepresentative.description:
The representative credited with this account's participation in the
order. Accounts in one block order can name different representatives.
A Moment user is sent as moment_user_id; name and email resolve from
the user directory when read. A person with no Moment login is sent
by name, with email when known. When both are set, moment_user_id is
always preferred.

moment_user_id.description: The Moment user who is the representative.

IsParameters.title: IS Parameters
IsParameters.description:
Parameters for an implementation-shortfall (arrival price) algo. The algo balances market
impact against timing risk to minimize slippage versus the arrival price, working more or
less aggressively based on the aggressiveness level. Order type and limit price are carried
on the order itself, not in these parameters.

start_time.description: Start of the absolute window to work the order.

end_time.description: End of the absolute window to work the order.

participate_opening_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the opening auction.

participate_closing_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the closing auction.

max_participation_percent.description: Hard ceiling on participation of market volume, as a percent (e.g. 20 = 20%).

LimitPrice.title: Limit Price
LimitPrice.description: The Percentage Price is represented as a percentage of par. For a typical $1,000 par value bond, a percentage price of $90 values the bond at $900. This is a clean price, which does not include accrued interest. Accepts a JSON number or a decimal string.

LotInstruction.title: Lot Instruction
LotInstruction.description:
Identifies a specific tax lot so the booking gateway can emit lot-level
VSP instructions to custodians. Buy-side flows leave it unset; when set,
all three fields are populated from the same lot record.

custodian_tax_lot_id.description: The tax lot ID assigned by the custodian.

lot_trade_date.description: Trade date of the tax lot, YYYYMMDD.

lot_purchase_price.description: Per-unit purchase price of the tax lot, decimal string.

OfferingID.description: The ID of the new-issue offering this order is placed against. Required for `ioi` orders; ignored for all other order types.
OfferingID.title: Offering ID

OrderSide.title: OrderSide
OrderSide.description:
Represents which side this order is on:

- buy
- sell

OrderSize.title: Amount
OrderSize.description:
The Amount of an order with a specified `type` indicating how the amount is represented.
- **Par:** Represents the order size in face value (e.g., a corporate bond with a $1,000 face value).
- **Notional:** Represents the order size in notional dollar value.
- **Shares:** Represents the order size in number of shares (for equities).

OrderType.description:
Represents the types of orders Moment currently supports.

- limit
- rfq_response
- market
- advisor_bw
- quote_wanted
- ioi
OrderType.title: OrderType

PovParameters.title: POV Parameters
PovParameters.description:
Parameters for a percentage-of-volume (POV) algo. The algo participates in the market at a
target percentage of the traded volume, speeding up or slowing down as market volume changes
rather than working to a fixed time schedule.

target_participation_percent.description: Target participation rate of market volume, as a percent (e.g. 20 = 20%).

max_participation_percent.description: Hard ceiling on participation, distinct from the target percent.

start_time.description: Start of the absolute window to work the order.

end_time.description: End of the absolute window to work the order.

participate_opening_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the opening auction.

participate_closing_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the closing auction.

Price.title: Price
Price.description: Price value with type specification for different pricing methods.

benchmark_isin.description: The ISIN of the benchmark security, required when type is 'spread'.

PriceValueType.title: Price Value Type
PriceValueType.description: The method used to represent the price value.

Protocol.title: Protocol
Protocol.description: The protocol used for the execution order.

contra_quote_id.description: The ID of the contra quote for the RFQ.

disclosure.description: The disclosure for the RFQ. Currently, only `disclosed` is supported.

due_after.description: Specifies how duration following RFQ creation, after which the RFQ becomes due.

subject_after.description: Specifies the duration following the due time (or submission time if no due time is defined) during which quotes are considered subject.

expire_after.description: Specifies the duration following the latest of due time, subject time, or submission time, after which the RFQ expires.

RecipientType.title: Recipient Type
RecipientType.description: The type of recipient for the fee.

RiskGroupID.description: The risk group ID to use for this order. If not specified, the default risk group for the organization will be used. The risk group must belong to the organization specified by ib_id. Orders for which the risk group does not belong to the specified organization will be rejected with "invalid risk group id."

RulesetMetadata.title: Ruleset Metadata
RulesetMetadata.description: Metadata about the ruleset that auto generated the order.

tree_version_id.description: The version ID of the ruleset that auto generated the order.

yield_to_maturity.description: Deprecated: not mapped to domain model, will be removed. Use post_fee_ytm instead.

yield_to_worst.description: Deprecated: not mapped to domain model, will be removed. Use post_fee_ytw instead.

pre_fee_ytw.description: Pre-fee yield to worst (street price, no fees).

post_fee_ytw.description: Post-fee yield to worst (inclusive of Moment fees).

pre_fee_ytm.description: Pre-fee yield to maturity (street price, no fees).

post_fee_ytm.description: Post-fee yield to maturity (inclusive of Moment fees).

Strategy.title: Strategy
Strategy.description: The strategy used for the execution order.

TimeInForce.title: Time In Force
TimeInForce.description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY.

user_id.description: the Moment ID for this user

bloomberg_id.description: the registered Bloomberg ID for this user

TwapParameters.title: TWAP Parameters
TwapParameters.description:
Parameters for a time-weighted average price (TWAP) algo. The algo slices the order into
smaller pieces and works them evenly over the specified time window, aiming to match the
time-weighted average price of the instrument over that window.

start_time.description: Start of the absolute window to work the order.

end_time.description: End of the absolute window to work the order.

participate_opening_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the opening auction.

participate_closing_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the closing auction.

max_participation_percent.description: Hard ceiling on participation of market volume, as a percent (e.g. 20 = 20%).

custodian_id.description: The ID of the custodian for the venue trader info.

venue_trader_id.description: The ID of the venue trader.

custodian_account_at_venue.description: The ID of the custodian account for the venue trader.

VwapParameters.title: VWAP Parameters
VwapParameters.description:
Parameters for a volume-weighted average price (VWAP) algo. The algo works the order in
proportion to the expected market volume profile over the specified time window, aiming to
match the volume-weighted average price of the instrument over that window.

start_time.description: Start of the absolute window to work the order.

end_time.description: End of the absolute window to work the order.

participate_opening_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the opening auction.

participate_closing_auction.description: Whether the algo should participate in the closing auction.

max_participation_percent.description: Hard ceiling on participation of market volume, as a percent (e.g. 20 = 20%).

WouldParameters.title: Would Parameters
WouldParameters.description: Models the "I-Would" trigger: a price at which the algo becomes aggressive / completes.

trigger_percent.description: Percentage of the order quantity to complete when the trigger price is reached.
